page.overview:
Who is AZ?

AZ is a character appearing in , and later Pokémon Legends: Z-A. He is a former king in Kalosian history.

Lysandre believes him to be a descendant of the original AZ, who built the Ultimate Weapon, but he is in fact the very same AZ.

In Pokémon Legends: Z-A, AZ now runs a hotel named Hotel Z in Lumiose City, before later passing away in the same game.

AZ is often depicted as an extremely tall man, standing over 9 feet (3 meters) tall in height, which is a side effect after activating the Ultimate Weapon. AZ carries a heavy, time-worn presence—one shaped by age, endurance, and a weight of history that clings to every aspect of his being. His facial expression is stern and deeply worn, marked by heavy lines and a downturned mouth that suggest sorrow held long and rarely voiced. His eyes are shadowed and intense, perpetually tired yet unwavering, conveying grief, regret, and an unrelenting sense of responsibility. Long white hair spills freely from beneath his worn knit cap, cascading past his shoulders in thick, untamed strands that frame his face like a mantle of time itself, emphasizing both his age and isolation. His posture is slightly hunched yet steady, burdened more by memory than by weakness; whether kneeling or standing, he appears grounded and resolute. He is tall and powerfully built, standing over 9 feet (3 meters) tall in height, which is a side effect after activating the Ultimate Weapon. Though his stature feels subdued—not diminished, but weighed down by centuries of loss rather than physical frailty.
